voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Two wooden boxes of fossil skulls, half a million years old. Peking, China, nineteen forty-one.
The remains of about forty early humans, each skull wrapped in cotton and gauze.
With war closing in, U.S. Marines were to take them to a ship on the coast, bound for New York.
Then came Pearl Harbor. The boxes never reached the ship, and were never seen again.
One lead: a Marine said he found a box of bones near that port in nineteen forty-seven. The likely spots are now built over. Only casts of them remain.
